ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: on the left in the figure is a benzene ring, fused with a nitrogen-containing six-membered heterocycle on the right. In the heterocycle on the right, an in-ring N can be seen; at the bottom there is an imine/double-bond carbon connected to R; the saturated carbon at the upper right is labeled H; the saturated carbon above is connected to an OPO2 phosphate group. The curved arrows in the figure are mechanism arrows, and the problem asks to ignore them. Then reason: represent the R position with the wildcard *; starting from the imine carbon connected to this substituent, write *C1=N; continuing along the heterocycle through N, the H-bearing saturated carbon, and the phosphate-substituted saturated carbon gives *C1=NCC(OP(=O)=O); finally attach the benzene-ring fragment fused with this heterocycle, c2ccccc21, completing the ring closure. Therefore the SMILES is *C1=NCC(OP(=O)=O)c2ccccc21.

method.method_draft: First describe the drawn molecule while ignoring the arrows: locate the benzene ring fused to the heterocyclic ring, identify the ring atoms around the heterocycle as wildcard-substituted imine carbon, ring nitrogen, saturated carbon bearing H, saturated carbon bearing phosphate, and the fused aromatic carbons. Then translate this connectivity into SMILES by starting at the wildcard substituent attachment, writing the imine carbon and ring closure as `*C1=NCC(...)`, placing the phosphate substituent on the top saturated carbon as `OP(=O)=O`, and finishing with the fused benzene as `c2ccccc21`, yielding `*C1=NCC(OP(=O)=O)c2ccccc21`.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中左侧是一个苯环，和右侧一个含氮六元杂环稠合。右侧杂环中可见一个环内 N，底部有一个与 R 相连的亚胺/双键碳；右上方的饱和碳标有 H；上方的饱和碳连有 OPO2 磷酸基团。图中的弯箭头是机理箭头，题目要求忽略它们。再推理：把 R 位用通配符 * 表示，从该取代基连接的亚胺碳开始写作 *C1=N；沿杂环继续经过 N、带 H 的饱和碳、带磷酸酯取代基的饱和碳，得到 *C1=NCC(OP(=O)=O)；最后接上与该杂环稠合的苯环片段 c2ccccc21，完成环闭合。因此 SMILES 为 *C1=NCC(OP(=O)=O)c2ccccc21。
